name: Double-buffered Voxel Storage and Routing
aliases: Graphics Memory Management and Voxel Routing
definition: A graphics memory module using DDR SDRAM divided into three colors (Red, Green, Blue) and two buffers (active/inactive) to buffer the entire volume of data for continuous display.
summary: Double-buffered Voxel Storage and Routing manages volumetric data by splitting DDR SDRAM into color-specific double buffers, enabling simultaneous scanning and modification via hardware-accelerated read-modify-write operations.
